name: Destructeur Imperial
description: Général légionnaire planifiant les campagnes de conquête multi-systèmes avec une précision martienne implacable.

subject.archetype: Destructeur Imperial — Hégémonie martienne Rare class obsidienne

loadout.armor_outfit: Heavy combat armor with thick crimson red plating showing battle scars and scorch marks, reinforced shoulder guards with dented imperial insignia, tactical undersuit at joints, magnetic combat boots locked to metal deck with distinctive faction engravings and glowing energy channel conduits running along seams
loadout.arsenal: Standard-issue heavy plasma rifle with imperial engravings, combat chainsword with serrated edge, tactical grenade bandolier across chest, targeting visor HUD displaying red lock-on data The weapon and gauntlets actively channel the character's decrease ability targeting enemy_with_highest, visible energy conduits linking weapon to body with flowing power

attitude.behavior: Combat specialist engaged in the heat of battle with weapon and body fully committed to the fight. Both hands pushed forward with intense focus, focused targeted concentrated nullification beam forming between palms and locking onto highest-value enemy with deadly precision
attitude.emotion: Lethal intensity — predator recognizing the perfect strike moment

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

palette_names.name: Crimson Red
palette_names.role: primary_accent — armor plating and blood mist in the air

palette_names.name: Gunmetal Black
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — structural elements and deepest shadows

palette_names.name: Blinding White
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — muzzle flash and explosive ignition

color_and_light.lighting_setup: cobalt steel frame with etched faction symbols running along each border edge, explosive backlight from ability discharge, dramatic rim lighting separating character from environmental chaos, volumetric light rays cutting through smoke and particles

camera.angle: Low dramatic angle emphasizing dominance, wide enough to show full environmental impact of the ability

scenography.setting: Planetary assault battlefield with artillery detonating sending massive dust columns skyward, advancing infantry silhouettes through smoke, orbital dropships descending under anti-aircraft fire, trenches littered with spent casings
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Intensely focused beam drilling into target with suppression field building around them as power is systematically dismantled layer by layer, beam unwavering and growing stronger, Ground scorched and vitrified creating glass-like tunnel through battlefield to target, all other targets completely unaffected showing terrifying precision, Artillery shells exploding in background sending up massive geysers of red dust, tracer rounds streaking across sky, crimson smoke grenades billowing, shrapnel flying past camera, ground cracking from impact tremors
